title: Yellow Split Pea Dhal
description: A spiced yellow split pea dhal simmered with onion, chilli, cumin and turmeric until soft and thick.
steps: Spray a large casserole with cooking spray; fry onion gently for 10 minutes. Add chilli and cumin seeds; stir-fry 1 minute.
Rinse split peas; add to casserole. Cover with stock; stir in turmeric, chilli powder and salt; bring to a rapid simmer.
Cover pot; reduce to low simmer; cook 45 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Taste to check peas are cooked with no bite. Add boiling water if getting too dry. Serve immediately.
notes: Add cauliflower florets 10 minutes before end of cooking for extra vegetables. Serve with flatbreads (p.188).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
